name: Fog Bank
oracle_text:
Defender (This creature can't attack.)
Flying
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by this creature.
blocked_sentences: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by this creature.

needs.what: a dealer-side total shield on the `prevent_damage` static: `{"effect": "prevent_damage", "prevent_all": true, "combat_only": true, "damage_source": {"self_only": true}}` preventing all combat damage this creature would deal to any recipient (creatures, players and planeswalkers). The 'dealt to' half is already expressible as a second `prevent_damage` static with `prevent_all`, `combat_only` and `affects: {"self_only": true}`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The loader accepts `damage_source` on `prevent_damage` only beside `affects_player` with no `affects`, and refuses `prevent_all` beside `affects_player`; the player-side reader (`prevented_player_damage`) skips `prevent_all` statics and only absorbs N. So there is no way to prevent all damage dealt BY a source. `replace_damage` filters by `damage_source` but only multiplies or adds, it cannot prevent. Writing only the 'dealt to' half would leave Fog Bank dealing combat damage, a different card.
